svg.title: Hip pain sorted by where the patient points: anterior or groin pain inside the joint (hip osteoarthritis, labral tear), lateral pain (greater trochanteric pain syndrome) and posterior buttock pain (piriformis syndrome), each with its presentation, exam, investigations and treatment in order, plus the socks question that separates lateral hip osteoarthritis from greater trochanteric pain syndrome

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • GTPS: pain on activity and lying on it · tender trochanter · single leg stance

Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • osteonecrosis: trauma, steroids, alcohol, lupus, sickle cell, radiation

svg.text: • snapping hip: very common · not painful → don't worry about it
